log.line: Rotation is finished; picked Bath & Bedtime (no book, repo record or DB books doc has it): an evergreen bath-and-bed routine topic. Seasonal options (Beach & Summer) were passed over because most of their subjects already appear in Ocean and Sports.

Searched titles: 'My First Bedtime Copy Coloring Book' (Justine Avery, 2021) exists and Twinkl has a free 'My First Bedtime Colouring Pack', so the title adds 'Bath &'; no 'My First Bath & Bedtime Coloring Book' turned up. Toddler bedtime coloring books are scarce in the results (one bedtime reveal book is for ages 4-8).

Drew 30 subjects in art/bedtime.js in four groups (9 bath time, 8 getting ready for bed, 9 night-time things, 4 sleepy friends), with new sleepy-face, star, crescent-moon, Zzz, heart and music-note helpers.

Contact sheet reviewed at full size; raised the bunk bed's top rail off the upper pillow, trimmed the sheep's fleece so its legs show and enlarged its head, simplified the rocking chair's back, enlarged the baby mobile's shapes and redrew the slippers as a top-view pair.

Wrote the title, subtitle, a description in four groups that match the 30 pages (9 + 8 + 9 + 4) and 7 keywords of 46 characters or fewer, with no brand names or other titles; renamed Bathtub and Sleepy Bear to Bubble Bath and Bedtime Bear so they don't repeat earlier books.

Ads kit: 15 exact and 8 phrase keywords, 49 negatives including bath-toy, board-book and sleep-aid terms and character brands; dropped 'cozy' from the usual negatives because parents search cozy bedtime books.
Ad texts 125, 131 and 122 characters, headlines 41, 39 and 38; build.js rejected 'the moon and stars' as a possible rating claim, so ad text 3 now says 'the moon and the night sky'.

64 pages; cover 17.3941 x 11.25 in matches KDP's formula and the bleed reaches every edge; 30 page labels match the description list; every picture has a blank back; cover, preview pages and both A+ images checked.
